summary: Recent AI advancements include several impactful products and research initiatives. Fund Momentum MCP offers real-time venture capital data for AI projects, enhancing investment decision-making. Tokenless, from Y Combinator, optimizes resource management by automatically switching models to save costs. Screenpipe, also from Y Combinator, boosts productivity by converting user work processes into AI agents for task automation. On the research front, Microsoft Research's Orchard framework enables efficient training and assessment of AI agents, while Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics ER 2 enhances robotics through advanced collaboration and task management.
recommendations: Focus on the most impactful products and research advancements in AI.
Highlight tools that offer significant improvements in productivity or functionality.
Remove discussions or queries that do not provide concrete advancements or insights in AI technology.

items.original: Gemini Robotics ER 2: powering robotics with video understanding, task orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration. Gemini Robotics ER 2 helps robots reason, collaborate, and solve real-world tasks. It represents a step change in video understanding, tool orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration for robotic applications.
items.rewritten: Gemini Robotics ER 2 is designed to enhance robotics through advanced video understanding, task management, and collaboration among multiple robots. This technology allows robots to think, work together, and tackle real-world challenges more effectively.

items.original: Orchard: An open framework for scalable agentic AI. Orchard is an open-source framework for the research community to train and evaluate AI agents across task types. It reduces complexity while supporting strong performance from smaller models by enabling researchers to reuse the same infrastructure. The post Orchard: An open framework for scalable agentic AI appeared first on Microsoft Research .
items.rewritten: Orchard is an open-source framework developed by Microsoft Research that allows the research community to train and assess AI agents across various tasks. It simplifies the process while enabling smaller models to achieve strong performance by allowing researchers to share the same infrastructure.
